<h1 style="font-size: 2.5em; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 20px;">Slack Provider</h1>
  

# slack Provider



## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    slack = {
      source = "pippiio.com/pippiio/slack"
    }
  }
}

provider "slack" {
  host  = "https://pippiio.com"
  token = "xoxb-1234567890"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `host` (String) URI for Slack API. May also be provided via SLACK_HOST environment variable.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer Token for Slack API. May also be provided via SLACK_TOKEN environment variable.
<br>
<br>
<br>
<h1 style="font-size: 2.5em; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 20px;">Data Sources</h1>
  

# slack_user_ids (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "slack_user_ids" "this" {
  usernames = ["u1", "u2"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `usernames` (Set of String) Set of usernames to get userids for.

### Read-Only

- `last_updated` (String)
- `slack_ids` (Map of String) The map of usernames and userids
<br>
<br>
<br>
<h1 style="font-size: 2.5em; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 20px;">Resources</h1>
  

# slack_message (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "slack_message" "this" {
  message   = "test"
  slack_ids = toset(values(data.slack_user_ids.this.slack_ids))
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `message` (String) Slack message to be sent
- `slack_ids` (Set of String) Set of slackids to send the message to

### Read-Only

- `last_updated` (String)
- `msg_map` (Attributes Map) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--msg_map))

<a id="nestedatt--msg_map"></a>
### Nested Schema for `msg_map`

Read-Only:

- `channel` (String) Channel id of the message
- `ts` (String) Time stamp of the message
